guides.treatment_action:
Recommended treatment actions:  
- Apply the latest security patches to SRV-04 to mitigate CVE-2021-44228 vulnerability  
- Implement automated configuration validation tools for application server settings  
- Establish a baseline configuration template for SRV-04 with hardened security parameters  
- Enforce least privilege principles for application server user accounts  
- Integrate configuration management with change management processes (control 8.32)  
- Deploy web filtering rules to block traffic patterns associated with remote code execution  
- Schedule regular vulnerability scans using technical vulnerability management (control 8.8)  
- Document configuration changes in a version-controlled repository  
- Conduct quarterly reviews of application server configurations by authorized personnel  
- Enable logging and monitoring for configuration changes on SRV-04

guides.evidence_description: Evidence for SRV-04 under control 8.9 (Configuration management): Apply the latest security patches to SRV-04 to mitigate CVE-2021-44228 vulnerability.

implementation_steps.title: Install Security Patches for CVE-2021-44228
implementation_steps.description: Check for and install the latest security updates addressing the remote code execution vulnerability.
implementation_steps.expected_result: Output confirms installation of hotfixes related to CVE-2021-44228 (e.g., KB5012165).
implementation_steps.evidence_capture: Save output of Get-HotFix to a text file named 'SRV-04_Patch_Validation.txt'.

implementation_steps.title: Export Application Server Configuration
implementation_steps.description: Export current application server configuration files for baseline comparison.
implementation_steps.expected_result: XML file 'Config_Export.xml' contains a complete snapshot of application directory contents.
implementation_steps.evidence_capture: Copy 'Config_Export.xml' to the centralized configuration management repository.

implementation_steps.title: Configure Group Policy Baseline
implementation_steps.description: Apply and export a hardened Group Policy baseline template for SRV-04.
implementation_steps.expected_result: HTML file 'GPO_Export.html' confirms successful application of security policies (e.g., restricted software, audit logging).
implementation_steps.evidence_capture: Archive 'GPO_Export.html' in the configuration management repository with version control metadata.

implementation_steps.title: Enforce Least Privilege for Application Users
implementation_steps.description: Modify application directory permissions to enforce least privilege.
implementation_steps.expected_result: ACL output shows only 'DOMAIN\AppUsers' group has modify permissions on application directory.
implementation_steps.evidence_capture: Save 'App_ACL.xml' to the configuration management repository.

implementation_steps.title: Deploy Web Filtering Rules
implementation_steps.description: Create Windows Firewall rules to block suspicious traffic patterns.
commands: New-NetFirewallRule -DisplayName "Block PowerShell Remoting" -Direction Inbound -LocalPort 5986 -Protocol TCP -Action Block
implementation_steps.expected_result: Firewall rule 'Block PowerShell Remoting' appears in the output with Action: Block.
implementation_steps.evidence_capture: Capture screenshot of firewall rule details in 'SRV-04_FW_Rules.png'.

implementation_steps.title: Enable Configuration Change Logging
implementation_steps.description: Configure audit policies to log configuration changes on SRV-04.
implementation_steps.expected_result: Event Viewer shows audit logs under 'Security' with successful/failed configuration change events.
implementation_steps.evidence_capture: Export Security event logs to 'SRV-04_Audit_Logs.evtx' and store in the repository.

implementation_steps.title: Schedule Vulnerability Scans
implementation_steps.description: Configure and run a vulnerability scan using Microsoft Baseline Security Analyzer.
implementation_steps.expected_result: Scan output confirms no critical vulnerabilities detected post-remediation.
implementation_steps.evidence_capture: Archive 'Vulnerability_Scan.xml' in the repository with scan date metadata.

implementation_steps.title: Document and Review Configuration Changes
implementation_steps.description: Commit configuration changes to version control and schedule quarterly reviews.
commands: git -C C:\Config_Repo commit -m "Baseline configuration for SRV-04"
implementation_steps.expected_result: Git repository shows commit hash confirming baseline configuration deployment.
implementation_steps.evidence_capture: Capture Git commit hash and store in 'SRV-04_Config_Revision.txt'.
